{{Quote|Do not worry, servant of the Republic. Peerce the Jedi will see that you are taken care of! If you can speak now tell Peerce who has done this thing to you!|Jedi Master Peerce to the officer|<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 28">[[Star Wars (1998) 28|''Star Wars'' (1998) 28]]</ref>}}
A [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] '''officer''' was a [[Republic Peace Officer]] with the [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]] [[Republic Security Force/Legends|Republic Guard]]. In [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]], while on patrol with his [[Squad/Legends|squad]], the officer was ambushed by the outlaw [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]]. His fellow [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] were killed and the officer was taken and tied by Sing to a building. When a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] including [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Peerce]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] [[J'Mikel]] found the officer, they attempted to free him. However, the captured officer was a [[Duel on Coruscant (30 BBY)|trap]] for the Jedi and Sing killed them.

==Behind the scenes==
The officer first appeared in [[Star Wars (1998) 28|''Star Wars'' (1998) 28]] which was written by [[Timothy Truman|Tim Truman]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[March 28]], [[2001]].
